label: Pixel 8 smartphone
description: Google Pixel 8 — 6.2-inch Tensor G3 phone with Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be, 2x2) and 5G sub-6/mmWave on US models; USB-C 3.2 with Ethernet support.
notes: Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be, 2x2 + 2x2, 2.4/5/6 GHz, 320 MHz, MLO) — one of the few phones here that can use multi-link operation, so it must not be modelled as a single-link 802.11ax client. Cellular: 5G sub-6 GHz plus mmWave (US models). USB-C 3.2 Gen 2 supports Ethernet adapters (usb0). Requires a Wi-Fi 7 AP to show any difference versus Pixel 7.
